2607.05240.title: Optimizing ML Workload Partitioning between CPUs and CIM Accelerators for Heterogeneous Computing
2607.05240.paper_summary: Computing-in-Memory (CIM) accelerators execute Matrix-Vector Multiplications (MVMs) in memory, making them a compelling solution for Machine Learning (ML) workloads. However, existing ML workload partitioning approaches for CIM accelerators do not fully account for Resistive Random Access Memory (RRAM) constraints such as limited memory, high write latency, and limited endurance. They also neglect parallelism, low-level architectural effects, or the Central Processing Unit (CPU) as a complementary compute resource. To address these limitations, we propose an Integer Linear Programming (ILP)-based workload partitioning framework for heterogeneous CPU-CIM systems. It minimizes end-to-end inference latency under RRAM constraints, captures parallelism, and combines empirical profiling with analytical models. Using our framework, heterogeneous CPU-CIM execution achieves speedups of up to 30.9x over CPU-only execution on an edge CPU and 7.3x over a high-performance CPU. A Design Space Exploration (DSE) yields further design insights for future CIM accelerators.
2607.05240.paper_summary_zh: 計算內存中的計算（CIM）加速器在內存中執行矩陣-向量乘法（MVM），使其成為機器學習（ML）工作負載的有吸引力解決方案。<lb/>然而，現有的針對CIM加速器的ML工作負載劃分方法並未充分考慮電阻隨機存取記憶體（RRAM）的限制，例如有限的內存、高寫入延遲和有限的耐用性。<lb/>它們還忽略了並行性、低層架構效應，或將中央處理單元（CPU）作為補充計算資源。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一種基於整數線性規劃（ILP）的異構CPU-CIM系統工作負載劃分框架。<lb/>該框架在RRAM限制下最小化端到端推理延遲，捕捉並行性，並將經驗剖析與分析模型相結合。<lb/>使用我們的框架，異構CPU-CIM執行在邊緣CPU上實現了相對於僅使用CPU的執行速度提升高達30.9倍，並在高性能CPU上提升了7.3倍。<lb/>設計空間探索（DSE）為未來的CIM加速器提供了進一步的設計見解。
